UGA.note: The article says only that a readiness assessment found gaps in AI-specific regulation; it does not state that no rule or authority exists.
No government use of AI is stated.
Sectors are named only as strategy priorities; no sectoral AI tool is stated.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that Uganda's Ministry of ICT and National Guidance, with NITA-U and AI Uganda, began drafting a national AI strategy in March 2026 and had completed a draft by August 2026, still awaiting senior ministry leadership review before going to Cabinet for approval.

UGA.note: No AI model, dataset or AI computing is stated.
Nothing stated on health data systems.
Nothing stated on government staff running systems.
No hub, incubator or park is stated.
